title: Introducing Spyglass
summary: We are thrilled to officially launch Spyglass, our powerful new tool designed to provide unparalleled clarity and insights for all users.

title: Elevated File Control and Display in Your Editor
summary: Take command of your content with new editor tools that allow you to seamlessly upload, manage, and customize the display of all your embedded files.

title: Introducing Our New Product Roadmap
summary: Get an exclusive look at our product's evolution with the brand new public roadmap, showcasing recent updates, upcoming features, and future plans in one transparent view.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: Enjoy a smoother experience with our newly enhanced checkboxes, now bigger, easier to click, and fully draggable for effortless task management.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: Experience seamless teamwork with our improved real-time collaboration features, making it easier than ever to work together and see what others are doing.

title: Enhanced Collaboration & Sharing
summary: Discover and collaborate on shared content effortlessly with enhanced visibility and search capabilities.

title: Unlock Global Audiences
summary: Experience Noeko in your preferred language as we roll out extensive support for international languages across the globe.

summary: We are thrilled to open-source Noeko's codebase, offering you unparalleled control, direct involvement in its growth, and complete transparency into our development.

title: Enhanced Knowledge Explorer
summary: We're transforming your knowledge graph into a powerful, interactive tool with advanced filtering and sharing capabilities to help you discover insights and collaborate effortlessly.

title: Refined Search and Personalized Collections
summary: Unlock the full potential of your knowledge base with enhanced search capabilities, enabling you to swiftly filter, sort, and save custom collections for easy access.

title: Flexible Content Display
summary: We are introducing flexible new ways to display and interact with your linked content, making your notes more intuitive and powerful.

title: Introducing Noeko Self-Hosted and Enterprise Plans
summary: Noeko is launching with robust self-hosting capabilities and flexible enterprise plans, empowering teams with greater control and tailored features.

title: Elevated Themes and Expansive New Options

title: Personalized Homepage Greetings
summary: We're enhancing your homepage experience with dynamic greetings that perfectly align with your local time, making every visit feel just right.

title: Effortless Tag Organization
summary: You'll soon be able to directly manage items associated with your tags, performing actions like unapplying tags or deleting content right from your tag view, drastically improving your workflow efficiency.
